memory.resources.description: Manage Prompt, PII, and Noise compositions and files. Browsing alternatives does not switch the active composition; PII and Noise include common rules.
memory.resources.noisePurpose: Noise rules decide only whether the current user prompt enters memory analysis. Common and selected country/region rules are combined.
memory.resources.piiPurpose: PII rules scrub content locally before memory processing. Regex, captures, condition formulas, and replacements must remain valid.
memory.resources.promptPurpose.postactio: PostAction L1 extracts candidate memories after a completed turn. Changes directly affect what can enter long-term memory.
PostAction L2 reviews and organizes candidates. Changes affect final writes, levels, priority, and profile nodes.
memory.resources.promptPurpose.precheckL: PreCheck L1 makes the first memory-recall decision before a user request executes. Preserve its structured decision fields.
PreCheck L2 completes second-stage recall analysis when needed. Preserve its structured decision fields.
memory.resources.promptPurpose.profileIn: Profile instructions convert natural-language adjustments into profile-node changes. Preserve operation and target field contracts.
memory.resources.promptPurpose.unknown: This prompt belongs to Core's structured inference path. Verify its schema before editing.
